content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Define homeostasis and explain its importance
Identify the internal conditions that need to be controlled
Describe the components of a control system including negative feedback
Explain the role of receptors, coordination centres, and effectors

is the maintenance of a constant internal environment despite changes in external conditions. It is essential for keeping cells alive and functioning properly, and involves multiple control systems working together throughout the body.
The maintenance of a stable internal environment
Conditions are kept within narrow limits
Essential for enzyme function and cell survival
Enzymes denature if too hot, slow if too cold
Cells shrink or burst with wrong water levels
